fields.label: Country
fields.note: Treat country name and code as one field. Either existing value blocks a missing-field fill. Enabled only on synthetic profiles today.

fields.label: Name
fields.note: Grouped components require their own missing-value checks. Do not inherit Kano's last-word surname splitting.

fields.label: Email
fields.note: Validate syntax and preserve existing addresses.

fields.label: Mobile
fields.note: Mobile and phone are separate targets. Do not copy one extracted number into both by default.

fields.label: Phone
fields.note: Use number-aware normalization; a calling code is not residence evidence.

fields.label: LinkedIn URL
fields.note: Validate URL and preserve other social links.

fields.label: Current position
fields.note: Check source date before coding a latest role.

fields.label: Current employer
fields.note: The public lookup also reads employment.current and employment.history; those are a different API shape.

fields.label: Current salary
fields.note: Composite amount/range/rate block, sometimes wrapped in salary. Treat zero as a value, not as empty.

fields.label: Expected salary
fields.note: Kano calls the target idealSalary. Amount, period, currency, and basis must remain distinct.

fields.label: Notice period / availability
fields.note: Kano also reads availabilityType and availableDate variants. Preserve exact duration; do not silently cap long notices to six months.

fields.label: Industry
fields.note: Observed multi-select in Kano's account. Independent of industry sub-category; verify IDs and options for the connected account.

fields.label: Industry sub-category
fields.note: Independent multi-select in Kano. Do not infer parent-child coupling.

fields.label: IT skills
fields.note: Use discovered picklists and preserve existing tags. No implicit append in a missing-only run.

fields.label: Currency
fields.note: Kano writes full option labels such as Malaysian Ringgit (MYR). Discover labels; do not send only an ISO code without checking the mapping.

fields.label: Residential status
fields.note: Do not assume this picklist means nationality, visa, relocation, or work rights. Confirm its actual options and intended meaning.

fields.label: Professional qualifications
fields.note: Account-specific multi-select. Existing values block a missing-only fill.

fields.label: Source
fields.note: Recruitment source is a separate field; do not infer it from a CV's contents.

fields.label: State
fields.note: Kano has state/suburb shortcuts. Garbage Truck must not treat those distinct concepts as interchangeable.

fields.label: Work type
fields.note: Observed as a protected field during salary updates, not a verified public-API write mapping.
